intro:
This document is generated. Do not edit it by hand. To change it, edit the CSV files in ui_blueprint/ (pairs.csv, behavior.csv, help.csv) or the HTML and the translations, then run build_ui_help_md.mjs.

The window has four areas, and each has its own tab on the settings page.

AreaSettings tabCovers
HeaderHeaderTitle bar, menus, and the theme, language and zoom controls
Editor and toolbarEditorEditing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat
Suggestion sidebarSidebarKnowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots
Bottom bar and systemSystemThe log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice

A setting and a part of the window relate in one of three ways.

RelationMeaning
LinkedThe window has a control for the same value; changing either one updates the other
ReflectedThe window has no control for it, but the setting changes how the window looks or behaves
Settings onlyThe window has no matching part

Each part of the window can be shown or hidden with its eye button under "Parts of the window" on the System tab. Essential parts cannot be hidden.

Settings tab: "Header". Title bar, menus, and the theme, language and zoom controls.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden

How it behaves

Help menu (hdr:menu-help)

WhenThen
Documentation is chosenOpens the in-app Help page: the guide to the window and the settings (four areas) as a searchable document. The repository page is a button inside it

Zoom display (header) (hdr:zoom-select)

WhenThen
Mouse wheel upZooms in one step (up to a limit)
Mouse wheel downZooms out one step (down to a limit)
Click (when not at 100%)Resets to 100%
HoverShows a magnifier with bold up (zoom in) and down (zoom out) arrows and the label Zoom, to say the mouse wheel works

Settings button (header gear) (hdr:settings-btn)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the settings page (the Header tab by default). It is essential and cannot be hidden

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
AppearanceLight, dark, or follow the system. The theme shows its light or dark face.LinkedAppearance mode button (header)
ThemeSwitch color palette and titlebar theme.LinkedTheme menu (header)
LanguageSwitch application locale.
UI Scaling (Zoom)Adjust the overall size of the application UI.LinkedZoom display (header)
Save locationFolder for new documents and the settings file (.settings.json).Settings only
Workspace Session (.vectorspace)Save or restore all active documents and tabs in a single bundle file.LinkedFile menu

What stops working when hidden

Hiding these parts shows a notice. The eye button brings them back.

PartWhen hidden
Menu barThe menu bar is hidden. The File, Edit, View, Window and Help menus are not shown.

Editor.title: Editor and toolbar
Editor.html:
Settings tab: "Editor". Editing, the toolbar, document tabs, the status bar and the LLM chat.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Editor toolbaredt:toolbarThe bar above the editor. It holds the Save button, the background tone, the font and its size, the LLM button and the settings gear. Hiding the bar hides all of them.Yes
Save buttonedt:saveThe Save button. The left part saves at once (while AutoSave waits for a location, it asks for one). The arrow opens a menu with the AutoSave switch, Save As and Save All. The lamp shows the AutoSave state (green = saving, orange = waiting for a location, grey = off). Hiding this part hides the button and the arrow together.Autosave (Linked), Save when typing pauses (Reflected), Save at each new line (Reflected)Yes (with a notice)
Background tone selectoredt:bg-toneEditor backgroundEditor background (Linked), Custom Background & Text Color (Linked)Yes
Font menu (toolbar)edt:font-familyChoose the fontFont Family (Linked)Yes
Text size menu (toolbar)edt:font-sizeChoose the text sizeSize (Linked)Yes
Editor AI buttonedt:ai-toggleLLM assistant: click to turn it on or off. When it is off, this turns it on and opens the chat dock. Without a model set up, it guides you to Settings.LLM (cloud AI) (Linked)Yes
Editor settings gearedt:quick-settingsOpen the editor preferencesYes
Document tabsedt:tab-barThe tabs of the open documents. Right-click a tab to duplicate it; the + button opens a new document. A tab with unsaved changes always asks before it closes.Yes (with a notice)
Editor status baredt:status-barThe strip under the editor: character count, line count, encoding, the document format (Markdown and Text are shown side by side and either can be chosen; the chosen format sets the default file name and extension of a manual save) and the Markdown preview button.Yes
Document format switchedt:document-formatThe format of this document. Point at it to list Markdown and Text; the one you choose sets the file name and extension when you saveFormat of new documents (Linked)Yes
Markdown preview buttonedt:markdown-previewShow or hide the rendered Markdown previewYes
LLM chat dockedt:llm-dockThe chat panel below the editor, for asking an LLM about your text or having it rewritten. It has the provider choice and the API key field, and buttons to clear the history, collapse and close it.LLM (chat and rewriting) (Linked), Gemini Model (Reflected), OpenAI Model (Reflected), Claude Model (Reflected)Yes
Chat dock: API key buttonedt:llm-key-configConfigure API KeyGoogle Gemini API Key (Linked), OpenAI API Key (Linked), Anthropic API Key (Linked)Yes
Chat dock: clear history buttonedt:llm-clear-chatClear the chat historyYes
Chat dock: collapse buttonedt:llm-collapseMinimize or expand the chat dockYes
Chat dock: close buttonedt:llm-closeClose the chat dockYes

How it behaves

Save button (edt:save)

WhenThen
Lamp is greenAutoSave is on and the document has a file
Lamp is orangeAutoSave is on but the document has no file yet; typing is kept as a draft only
Lamp is greyAutoSave is off (the user turned it off)

Editor AI button (edt:ai-toggle)

WhenThen
The model is not set up (no key)Asks to confirm, then opens the LLM card on the Editor tab of the settings
LLM is offTurns LLM on and opens the chat dock. Embedding is not changed. Calls to Gemini and the like become possible
LLM is onTurns LLM off and closes the chat dock. While off, chat, Ctrl+K, the right-click LLM chat and Gemini suggestions are unavailable. Embedding is not changed
When switchedShows the same sentence in a toast and in the log (for example [AI] LLM: ON → OFF)

Editor settings gear (edt:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the Editor tab of the settings page

Document format switch (edt:document-format)

WhenThen
HoverShows both formats (Markdown and Text) side by side and either can be chosen. The chosen format sets the default file name and extension in the manual save dialog (it can still be changed there)

LLM chat dock (edt:llm-dock)

WhenThen
LLM is offCloses the chat dock and disables input, send and clear
Drag the top borderChanges the dock height. Double-click resets it. The height is remembered (can be turned off in the settings)
A question about the app (for example what Embedding is or whether the font can be changed)Puts the matching cards of the guide in front of the question and has the LLM answer within them. What the guide does not cover is answered with I do not know and a pointer to Settings or the Guide button. Other requests (such as rewriting a text) get nothing added

Chat dock: API key button (edt:llm-key-config)

WhenThen
A key is storedShows only the last 4 characters. Empty means unchanged, typing overwrites, the delete button removes it. The key stays in the main process and is never sent back to the window

Sidebar.title: Suggestion sidebar
Sidebar.html:
Settings tab: "Sidebar". Knowledge search and suggestions, the guideline and the knowledge slots.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Suggestion sidebarsbr:sidebarDrag to resize the sidebarYes (with a notice)
Embedding on/off buttonsbr:embedding-toggleEmbedding assistant: click to turn real-time semantic suggestions on or offEmbedding assistant (Linked), EMBEDDING CATALOG (Reflected)Yes
Sidebar settings gearsbr:quick-settingsOpen the vector and knowledge settingsYes
Guideline cardsbr:guideline-cardThe card for the active guideline (preset). Click to open or close it. You can insert a template, add files and unload the loaded guideline (this only detaches the file and deletes no data).Yes (with a notice)
Import dictionary buttonsbr:import-dictionaryLoad PresetImport Dictionary (Linked)Yes
Knowledge slots cardsbr:knowledge-cardThe card for the knowledge slots. Click to open or close it. Add files to add slots and detach a file with the X of its row. With two or more slots an Unload All button also appears (it only detaches files and deletes no data; it always asks to confirm). A badge shows how many slots are loaded. With LLM on and Embedding off Gemini suggestions appear in addition to the dictionary search.Yes (with a notice)
Add knowledge slot buttonsbr:add-slotAdd Knowledge SlotYes
Minimum score field (sidebar)sbr:score-filterMinimum similarity score for suggestions (50% - 99%)Minimum Similarity Score (%) (Linked)Yes
Result limit menu (sidebar)sbr:limit-selectMaximum number of suggestionsSearch Results Limit (Linked)Yes
Full metadata checkbox (sidebar)sbr:metadata-toggleShow full metadata and attributes in suggestion resultsShow Full Metadata (Linked)Yes
Editor options cardsbr:editor-options-cardThe card that lists every Monaco editor option. Click to expand or collapse. The search box filters by name or description. Changing an option updates the main editor at once and is saved with the settings. A changed option gets a coloured bar and a ↺ button that restores that option alone; the button in the card header restores them all. Options the settings page already owns (font, word wrap, line numbers and so on) are read-only here. See MONACO_OPTIONS.md for the full list.Yes
Collapsed sidebar railsbr:railThe narrow column of icons that appears while the sidebar is collapsed. It has the expand, Guidelines and Knowledge buttons.Yes

Embedding on/off button (sbr:embedding-toggle)

WhenThen
Embedding is offTurns Embedding on. LLM is not changed
Embedding is onTurns Embedding off (the embedding model is not used). LLM is not changed

WhenThen

System.title: Bottom bar and system
System.html:
Settings tab: "System". The log, the pipeline state, the save result and the update notice.

Parts of the window

PartKeyDescriptionRelated settingCan be hidden
Log panel: clear buttonsys:log-clearClear all log entries from the panelSystem log (Linked)Yes
Log panel: copy buttonsys:log-copyCopy all log entries to the clipboardSystem log (Linked)Yes
Log panel: save buttonsys:log-downloadSave all log entries to a text fileSystem log (Linked)Yes
Bottom barsys:bottom-barThe bar at the bottom of the window: the log button, the pipeline state, the System settings gear, the update notice, the save result and the memory use.Yes (with a notice)
Log panelsys:log-consoleOpen or close the log panelLog panel at startup (Reflected), Remember layout (Reflected), Log time format (Reflected), Log time zone (Reflected)Yes
Status info (characters, lines, encoding)sys:status-metaShows how much memory (RAM) the app uses.Yes
Pipeline status LEDssys:pipeline-meterSeven lamps for the startup state: 1 Config, 2 Theme, 3 Locale, 4 Editor, 5 Rust engine, 6 AI model, 7 Knowledge base (HNSW). Point at a lamp for details. Green means ready, orange means preparing, grey means switched off on purpose or not loaded, red means an error. Standby on the AI model and the knowledge base only means not loaded yet; it is not a fault. Click an orange, grey or red lamp to jump to where it is fixed (an error on 5 Rust engine opens the Help entry for when the Rust engine does not load).Yes
System settings gearsys:quick-settingsOpen the system and log settingsYes
Update indicatorsys:update-statusShows the update state: checking, update available (with the version), preparing. Click it when an update is available to confirm the download; the portable build opens the release page instead. It stays hidden while there is no update information.Yes
Save status indicatorsys:save-statusShows the result of the latest save. The autosave state and failures appear here and on the Save button's lamp.Yes

How it behaves

Log panel (sys:log-console)

WhenThen
Click the log row (button)Opens or closes the log panel
Drag the top borderChanges the panel height. Double-click resets it. The height is remembered (can be turned off in the settings)

Pipeline status LEDs (sys:pipeline-meter)

WhenThen
Lamp is greenThe stage is ready. Clicking does not move anywhere
Lamp is orange or grey (1 Config / 2 Theme / 3 Locale / 4 Editor / 6 AI model / 7 Knowledge base)Click to jump to the place that fixes it (1 System, 2 and 3 Header, 4 Editor, 6 and 7 the AI search tab)
Lamp 5 Rust engine is redClick to open the Help entry for when the Rust engine does not load. Typical causes are a version mismatch of the package (@1abcdefggs/vect-or-engine) or a missing file
When 6 AI model becomes readyWrites the log line once. It is not written for each downloaded file

System settings gear (sys:quick-settings)

WhenThen
ClickOpens the System tab of the settings page

Settings

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Confirm before closingAsk first when you close something with ×, so a stray click cannot close it. Tabs with unsaved changes are always asked about.Settings only
Reload Editor WindowRedraws the editor window only; the app keeps running. Use this when the screen looks wrong or after a UI change. Nothing is deleted.Settings only
Restart ApplicationCloses the whole app and starts it again, including the engine and background processes. Use this after an update or when the engine or a model stops responding. Settings, documents, cached models, Knowledge Slots, and the encrypted Gemini key are kept.Settings only
Clear Application CacheClears Electron session cache and temporary renderer resources. It does not delete documents, Knowledge Slots, settings, downloaded model files, or API keys.Settings only
Restore Default SettingsResets everything to the first-run state: preferences, the loaded KNOWLEDGE and guideline, the API keys and the downloaded models. The first-run setup shows again.Settings only
Dev resetSame as the reset above, but keeps the model files, the API keys, the loaded KNOWLEDGE and guideline, and the save folder. The first-run setup shows again.Settings only

System log

SettingDescriptionRelationMatching part of the window
Same action as Clear in the log panelLinkedLog panel: clear button
Log panel at startupWhether the log panel is open when the app starts.ReflectedLog panel
Log time formatHow each log time is shown. Only the display changes; the stored time is always the same. Examples for 16:47:01 UTC: 24 hours: 16:47:01. 12 hours: 04:47:01 PM. Follow OS: the format of your Windows region. ISO 8601: 2026-10-25T16:47:01.123Z (always UTC).ReflectedLog panel
Log time zoneThe time zone of the log times. Local shows this computer's time zone (the default). UTC shows Coordinated Universal Time. ISO 8601 is always UTC, whatever this is set to.ReflectedLog panel
Remember layoutRemembers the height of the log panel and the chat dock and the width of the sidebar, and restores them at the next start. Turning it off forgets them.ReflectedLog panel
